metadata.description: Mods of the two-tier-dev system: handoff (automatic handoff + fresh context), window-guard (rate-limit status line and the week guard), phase-start (/phase), spec-board (/board).

plugins.name: handoff
plugins.description: Writes a handoff from the live transcript past a context threshold or on /handoff, then /clear and resume.

plugins.name: window-guard
plugins.description: Status line of the rate-limit windows; above window_seven_day_pct of budgets.json a tool call is denied until /window override. Absorbs limits.

plugins.name: phase-start
plugins.description: /phase sends docs/PROMPT.txt as your message on the branch it names and refuses on another; /phase resume, /phase halt.

plugins.name: spec-board
plugins.description: /board: the phase board beside the chat — SPEC items against docs/evidence, markers, spec-gate, verdict, open STOP; files only, no model, no network.
